lines: One chunk holds at least 90.0 % of a page, so the browser fetches practically the whole page before it shows anything:
urbanduplicati-main.js: 1 file, 3,646,110 B, and 5 chunks of 365,680 B its runtime loads later, of which urbanduplicati-main.js is 3,646,110 B (90.9 %).
urbanduplicati-admin.js: 1 file, 3,498,707 B, and 5 chunks of 365,680 B its runtime loads later, of which urbanduplicati-admin.js is 3,498,707 B (90.5 %).

Code splitting puts what the first paint does not need behind a dynamic import, and then the browser fetches it when the code asks. Which part of a page that is does not follow from the build output; the source decides it.
1 package is imported by their root in src, so the whole barrel is reachable and the bundler keeps whatever it cannot prove unused:

@nextcloud/vue: 1,558,936 B in 238 modules, 42.8 % of the static path of urbanduplicati-main.js, imported by its root in 9 files: App.vue (NcAppContent, NcAppNavigation, NcAppNavigationItem, ...), components/details/DryRunPanel.vue (NcButton), and 7 more.
Importing the module that is used instead of the package root lets the bundler drop the rest of the barrel.
ncmake's lint-vue-imports workflow gates exactly this specifier for @nextcloud/vue, so this finding is that red check with a byte figure attached.

80 components of @nextcloud/vue are delivered although no file in src names them, no other dependency names them and no component named by either imports them: 272,859 B, 7.5 % of the static path of urbanduplicati-main.js, next to 8 components the source names, 2 that other dependencies name and 9 those pull in.
NcRichText 48,450 B, NcAppSidebar 16,628 B, NcRichContenteditable 12,964 B, NcCheckboxRadioSwitch 11,693 B, NcAvatar 10,189 B, NcCollectionList 9,696 B, and 74 more.
These arrive through the root import: under a barrel the whole component set is reachable, so the bundler must keep it. Per-component imports leave it free to drop what the app never names.

Written against: @nextcloud/vue 8.37.0, 117 delivered packages; vue 2.7.16, 12 delivered packages; vue-router 3.6.5, 3 delivered packages; linkifyjs 4.3.2, 2 delivered packages; css-loader 7.1.4, 4 delivered packages.
Other delivered libraries: 7, buffer 6.0.3, toastify-js 1.12.0, path-browserify 1.0.1, style-loader 4.0.0, process 0.11.10, base64-js 1.5.1, and 1 more.

7 delivered files look like a webpack or CommonJS bundle. Their internal structure is not derivable from the artefact, so each counts as one file and the chunk figures below say nothing about what is inside them.
Every delivered file in js carries a source map, so every byte can be charged to the package and the module it came from.
